name: spark-one-11-eval-jev
cmd: python3 -m spark_one.adapters.run --adapter jev --model jev-latest --bank data/generated/bank --split test --limit 400 --max-usd ${MAX_USD:-5} --out runs/eval-only/jev/test_preds.jsonl && python3 -m spark_one.eval.harness --bank data/generated/bank --preds runs/eval-only/jev/test_preds.jsonl --out runs/eval-only/jev/eval --name 'Jev (eval only)'
